errors.evidence: The x-axis does not have a linear scale; the intervals between tick marks are not uniform (e.g., the distance between 0.9 and 1 is the same as between 1 and 2).
The x-axis does not start at 0; the first label on the x-axis is "w/o".

errors.text_span: has tick labels at each 0.1 interval
errors.evidence: The x-axis tick labels are not at each 0.1 interval throughout the entire range. After 1, the interval changes to 1 (i.e., 1, 2, 3).
The y-axis range shown in the plot is from 72.0% to 75.5%. One data point for MatDetector is even above 75.5%.
For the MatDetector line, the first data point is at x-label "w/o" (not 0) and its value is approximately 72.6%, not 72.2%.
The MatDetector line at λ = 0.1 is at approximately 72.6%, not 73.0%. The value barely changes from the first point.
The MatDetector line actually slightly increases from λ = 0.1 (approx. 72.6%) to λ = 0.2 (approx. 72.7%), it does not decrease.
For the MatDetector line, the value at λ = 0.5 is approximately 73.4%, not 74.1%.

errors.text_span: reaching a peak of 74.5% at λ = 0.6
errors.evidence: This misidentifies the peak of the MatDetector line. The actual peak is at λ = 1 with a value of approximately 75.6%.
The MatDetector line value at λ = 0.7 is approximately 73.7%, not 74.2%. It also does not remain steady; it decreases from the previous point at λ = 0.6.
The MatDetector line actually increases to approximately 74.2% at λ = 0.8, it does not decrease to 73.5%.
For the ChemDataExtractor line, the first data point is at x-label "w/o" (not 0) and its value is approximately 72.6%, not 72.4%.
For the ChemDataExtractor line, the value at λ = 0.2 is approximately 72.6%, not 73.0%.
The ChemDataExtractor line decreases to approximately 72.4% at λ = 0.3, it does not increase to 73.4%.
The ChemDataExtractor line increases to approximately 73.1% at λ = 0.4, it does not decline to 72.8%.
The ChemDataExtractor line decreases to approximately 72.7% at λ = 0.6, it does not increase to 73.7%.
The ChemDataExtractor line increases to approximately 73.2% at λ = 0.7, it does not decrease.
For the ChemDataExtractor line, the value at λ = 2.0 is approximately 73.2%, not 72.5%.
The description fails to mention the markers used for each line (circles for MatDetector and squares for ChemDataExtractor), which are key visual elements for differentiating the series.

errors.text_span: A solid purple line, labeled “MatDetector (ours),” begins at 72.2% at λ = 0 and increases to 73.0% at λ = 0.1, and decreases to 72.7% at λ = 0.2. The line rises to 73.6% at λ = 0.3, dips to 72.9% at λ = 0.4, rises to 74.1% at λ = 0.5, and fluctuates, reaching a peak of 74.5% at λ = 0.6 and remains steady at 74.2% at λ = 0.7, before decreasing to 73.5% at λ = 0.8 and 72.8% at λ = 2.0, eventually ending at 72.2% at λ = 3.0. A dashed blue line, labeled “ChemDataExtractor,” begins at 72.4% at λ = 0, decreases to 72.3% at λ = 0.1, subsequently increases to 73.0% at λ = 0.2, and increases to 73.4% at λ = 0.3, then declines to 72.8% at λ = 0.4, before increasing to 73.6% at λ = 0.5, to 73.7% at λ = 0.6, decreases to 73.3% at λ = 0.7, and then declines to 72.7% at λ = 0.8, and 72.5% at λ = 2.0, ultimately ending at 72.2% at λ = 3.0.
errors.evidence: The description provides an exhaustive, point-by-point recitation of the data, which is both difficult to read and full of numerical errors. A summary of the overall trend, including start, peak, and end points, would be much clearer and more effective.
